notes: Printed as "TABLE XV—PART A—DISTRIBUTION OF LANGUAGE BY DIVISION" (Baroda calls Part I "Part A"); opening pp. 108-109 = leaves 116-117, complete on this opening (75 rows). Leaf 116 holds cols 1-10 (State total, Baroda City, Amreli Division); cols 11-22 are on leaf 117. Khandeshi (row 22) State Females printed as 25 (glyph looks like 5), but 38 - 12 = 26 and divisions sum to 26 (City 0, Baroda 4, Navsari 22): kept 25 as printed; likely a broken 6. Row 1 "BARODA STATE" is the grand total of all languages (language recorded as "All languages"). Italic rows (Central Group, Bhil Dialects, Pahari/Mediate/Marathi/Eastern/North West Groups) are group subtotals. Banjari is a dialect indented under Rajasthani and is included in Rajasthani (Central Group sum works without it). Label spellings: "Kashmiri and Chitrali" and "Pendhari" (row 58, first letter faint, could be read "Fendhari") faint in print. Extra field "serial" = printed serial number.
